items.title: Home Cinema Streaming Platform
items.summary: Full-stack streaming platform with HLS playback, authentication, subscription gating, and Vimeo integration.
items.description: Home cinema platform where users can purchase and stream movies. Features HLS video playback with adaptive bitrate, Firebase authentication, subscription-based content gating, and Vimeo integration. Includes a customer-facing React app, an admin panel for content management, and a Node.js backend with REST APIs.

items.title: Gaming Platform
items.summary: Modern gaming platform with a Next.js front-end and NestJS services.
items.description: Gaming platform combining a Next.js front-end with a NestJS backend. Game catalog, session handling, and a modular service architecture designed for adding new titles without ceremony.

items.title: NestJS Microservice Architecture
items.summary: Production-grade microservice backend with API gateway, centralized auth, and user management.
items.description: Microservice architecture for a video streaming platform. API gateway with circuit-breaker and exponential-backoff retry patterns, a centralized auth service with RS256 JWT tokens and role-based access control, and a user service managing profiles, subscriptions, and watch history. Services communicate over RabbitMQ with Redis caching and PostgreSQL persistence. Includes Docker Compose orchestration, OpenTelemetry tracing, and Prometheus metrics.

items.title: Restaurant POS System
items.summary: Full-stack point-of-sale system for restaurant order and transaction management.
items.description: Point-of-sale system built for restaurant operations. React frontend for order processing and staff workflows, a Bootstrap-based admin panel for back-office management, and a Node.js backend handling business logic, data models, and API routing.

items.title: HLS Video Player
items.summary: Custom HLS player with M3U8 streaming and a NestJS video conversion backend.
items.description: Custom HLS video player built in Next.js supporting M3U8 streams with adaptive bitrate playback and quality selection. Paired with a NestJS backend service that handles video uploads and converts them into HLS format for streaming.

items.title: Influencer Management System
items.summary: Web application for managing influencer campaigns, profiles, and collaboration workflows.
items.description: Management platform for tracking influencer profiles, campaign workflows, and collaboration pipelines. Frontend built with a modern React stack. Backend to be published separately.

items.title: Three.js Interactive Globe
items.summary: Explorable 3D globe rendered entirely in the browser.
items.description: Interactive 3D globe built with Three.js — explorable, animated, and fully rendered in the browser. Shader-driven atmosphere, point data overlays, and lightweight interaction model.

items.title: Chicken Road Crash Game
items.summary: Crash-style arcade game built in Cocos Creator with a real-time NestJS backend.
items.description: Crash-style arcade game built in Cocos Creator with a real-time NestJS backend for multiplayer logic, server-authoritative game state, and deterministic outcomes.

items.title: Treasure Hunt Crash Game
items.summary: Treasure-themed crash game with animated gameplay and server-side state.
items.description: Treasure-themed crash game with animated gameplay and server-side game state management. Session lifecycle, animations, and payout logic kept authoritative on the NestJS service.

items.title: Lottery Scratch Game
items.summary: Interactive scratch card lottery with Cocos animations and server-side ticket generation.
items.description: Interactive scratch card lottery game with tactile Cocos Creator animations and a NestJS ticket-generation service. Outcomes are built from a canonical weight table, validated server-side, and persisted to PostgreSQL.

items.title: Omi Card Game
items.summary: Sri Lankan trick-taking card game with a Next.js frontend and a Rust backend.
items.description: Digital version of Omi, a 4-player team-based trick-taking card game. Next.js frontend with real-time game UI, paired with a Rust backend on SpacetimeDB handling deck management, trump selection, trick resolution, scoring, and AI bot opponents. First team to 10 points wins.
